change: Caffeine — Honor immediate expiry when the cache also has a size limit
deployment: Pinned CacheFactory over Caffeine JCache 2.6.1 and the setup's JCache API 1.0.0 override.
assumptions: Fresh manager/cache, direct executor, constant ticker and zero or one-minute creation/update/read expiry, maximum two entries where enabled.

questions.observer: Observe both gets and the create/update/read callbacks in order after two puts of the same key.
questions.basis: Zero expiry removes each newly created entry. Positive expiry preserves the value and should invoke the policy at all four operations.

questions.observer: Check independent size and expiry profiles, and count survivors after maintenance without choosing a victim.
questions.basis: Unexpired entries survive until size maintenance. A size bound of two permits exactly two entries after nine keys.
